guest.titre: Business Strategist, Retreat Leader, Creator of the Business Breakthrough Program
guest.bio_context: For nearly two decades, Michelle has helped coaches, consultants, speakers, and thought leaders build scalable businesses through transformational experiences. She has led more than 150 retreats and taught thousands how to create meaningful impact and recurring revenue. She is also an author, having created an adventure book for dreamers titled But I Want to Fly, with artwork by Kiki Kulahari.

pending_qa.q: Why is congruency more important than appearing perfect when holding retreat space?
pending_qa.r: People think they need to show up with all their shit together so participants can trust them, but what is actually needed is congruency. If you are not okay and you are pretending to be okay, there is a disharmony and disconnect. Horses teach this—they respond to congruency, not perfection. If you show them you are not okay, they trust you.

pending_qa.q: What modalities and community formats does Michelle Villalobos use to facilitate transformational work with clients?
pending_qa.r: Michelle works with clients both one-on-one and in circle-based community retreats twice a year. She brings in modalities such as breathwork, somato-respiratory integration, and network spinal care. Her retreats evolved from business-focused mastermind formats to whole-being experiences where participants engage in practices like breathwork with instructors and somatic work rather than traditional table-based strategy sessions.
